set.body:
Problem: the explicit SupportBasis on bd-01M19956MFSG7076QE4J66T7E9 can prove support-accounting consistency, but it does not prove that an arbitrary LocalCostModel computed total from that basis, its declared FunctionPrior, external policy, or provider configuration. A custom model can report basis A and compute with B. Publishing the result as invocation-authenticated would be a fabricated license.

Required outcome: a typed, checked CostModelInvocationReceipt derived from the invocation rather than caller labels. It binds the actual model/configuration identity, exact support weights, function prior, external floor/mismatch policy, optional provider fingerprints/geometry, schema, and the resulting HsmmResult. Every default-model total must be recomputable from carried term values and the receipt. Custom models either supply a verifiable checked receipt through an explicit protocol or the result remains explicitly InternallyConsistent/Unverified and is ineligible for calibrated production claims.

Courts: caller-selected model class or identity; declared weights A while calculating with B; prior/floor/provider swap with stable labels; wire self-asserting its own expected receipt; cached total changed while terms/config remain fixed; valid default invocation round-trip; and an honest unverified custom-model control. No raw video enters the repo.

This is downstream of SupportAssessment and upstream of calibration/production-output claims. It need not block internal exploratory inference if the authority status stays explicit.
set.title: P0 align: bind HsmmResult totals to an admitted cost-model invocation receipt
